description: This file defines interfaces, data structures, constants, and function pointer types for the BREE Site Resource Manager Object, including resource management and mapping functionalities.

classes.name: BREE_SRM_OBJECT
classes.description: Represents the BREE Site Resource Manager object, encapsulating resource list and management function pointers.

methods.name: RegisterCookedResource
methods.description: Registers a cooked resource with the resource manager.

methods.name: UnregisterCookedResource
methods.description: Unregisters a cooked resource from the resource manager.

methods.name: MapCookedResource
methods.description: Maps a URL to a cooked resource.

methods.name: LoadCookedResources
methods.description: Loads all cooked resources into the resource manager.
